title: Managing deals and monitoring rotten status on Kanban board

steps.expect: Kanban pipeline view loads displaying deal stages and deal cards
REST POST /wp-json/wpdev/v1/deals/101/move returns HTTP 200 with updated stage, win probability, and total pipeline value
Inactive deal card displays distinct visual rotten alert badge indicating required follow-up

title: Linking contacts to corporate accounts and viewing activity timeline

steps.expect: Contact detail profile view loads
HTTP 200 OK returned confirming association and custom field updates
Associated company details and updated field mappings appear on the contact's unified activity timeline

title: Tracking scheduled client tasks on team calendar

steps.expect: Team calendar view loads successfully
Phone calls, meetings, and follow-ups display on scheduled dates with interactive completion checkboxes

title: Filtering sales conversion funnel and revenue forecasting reports

steps.expect: Analytics dashboard loads
HTTP 200 OK returned with filtered analytics payload
Conversion funnel, revenue forecast chart, and deal loss breakdown render filtered metrics for the selected sales rep and date range

title: Frontend lead capture form submission creates contact and deal

steps.expect: Frontend page rendering shortcode [didar_lead_form id="1"] loads
Form submits successfully with confirmation message
HTTP 200 OK returned with new contact and associated deal present in default pipeline stage

title: Automated SMS notification trigger on stage change

steps.expect: SMS Gateway settings page displays configured API credentials
Deal advances to designated stage triggering automated SMS dispatch
Dispatch log returns entry with status 'sent' for deal 105

title: Executing workflow automation triggers when deal transitions to Won stage

steps.expect: Deal state updates to 'Won'
Workflow engine automatically assigns follow-up task to owner and triggers corresponding notification rule

title: Enforcing two-gate privacy and role-based filtering on deal listings

steps.expect: User authenticated successfully
HTTP 200 OK payload strictly filters out unassigned deals and deals belonging to other teams based on domain policies
